title: Introduce last edited check to Smart Edit
body:
### What would you like to be added?

In the case when a file has been edited by a user or an external process since the agent last edited the file, we should a.) detect this in Smart Edit, and b.) ensure the tool sees the new version of this content during the healing process.

### Why is this needed?

This can help reduce EDIT_NO_OCCURRENCE errors, but also scenarios where an edit is successful but clobbers user or external tool edits that have been made since the agent last made changes.

linked_prs.title: fix(core): refresh file contents in smart edit given newer edits from user/external process
linked_prs.body:
## TLDR

This PR makes a change to improve Smart Edit's behavior around a common loss pattern.

It does so by adding a check during `attemptSelfCorrection` that refreshes the file content _if we find that either the user has edited the file since the agent last did so_. This can help reduce `EDIT_NO_OCCURRENCE` errors due to stale content that the model is using to perform the edit.

## Dive Deeper

Adding the refreshing of file contents increases the chance of a successful edit while also preventing the model from overwriting more recent user changes.

## Reviewer Test Plan

1. Run npx https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli#agmsb/remove-no-changes-llm-judgment
2. Work in a test directory. Create a new file (IE test.txt). Ask the model to write a poem in that file.
3. Make changes to that poem in an editor.
4. Ask the model to make changes that include your changes from the editor.
5. Ensure the model respects those changes in edit and does not revert them.
